name: The Singapore EDITION
short_description: The EDITION brand's first Southeast Asian hotel, on Cuscaden Road near Orchard Road, with a 43-metre rooftop pool.
ai_summary: The Singapore EDITION is the Ian Schrager-Marriott EDITION brand's first Southeast Asian property, opened in November 2023 on Cuscaden Road just off Orchard Road. The hotel is designed by Safdie Architects and DP Architects, with five restaurants and bars including FYSH by chef Josh Niland, the Punch Room, a pink-lit lobby bar, and what's billed as Orchard Road's longest rooftop pool at 43 metres. On TripAdvisor it ranks among the top 15 hotels in Singapore, and reviews consistently praise the elegant, calming room design, spotless housekeeping, and warm, professional service, positioning it as one of Bonvoy's most design-forward luxury entries in the city. It suits travelers who want a fashion- and design-led luxury stay over a more traditional 5-star format, with easy access to Orchard Road shopping and the Botanic Gardens. The most frequently repeated watchouts involve dining logistics rather than the core stay: the 24-hour in-room dining menu is more limited than the signature restaurants, and orders are capped at two items at breakfast. A handful of reviews also mention slower-than-expected front-desk response and luggage delivery, and staff have been noted as candid about ongoing construction or fit-out work elsewhere on the property. Rates run at the high end of the market even by Orchard Road luxury standards.

faqs.question: What makes The Singapore EDITION different from other Marriott Bonvoy luxury hotels in the city?
faqs.answer: It's the EDITION brand's first Southeast Asian property, blending Ian Schrager's design-led format with Safdie Architects' building design, a 43-metre rooftop pool, and five restaurants including FYSH by chef Josh Niland -- a more fashion-forward take on luxury than Bonvoy's traditional 5-star brands.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included at The Singapore EDITION?
faqs.answer: Dining is available, but guest reviews note that both breakfast and 24-hour in-room dining come with restrictions -- breakfast orders are capped at two items, and the in-room menu is more limited than the hotel's signature restaurants.

reviews.title: We review the Singapore EDITION, a haven of calm amidst urban energy
reviews.author: Natasha Tang
reviews.summary: A design-forward review praising Safdie's architecture, suspended gardens and cream-toned Garden King rooms, plus Josh Niland's sustainable FYSH seafood, the rooftop pool and warm personalized service in an urban sanctuary setting.

reviews.title: The Singapore Edition: really very good
reviews.author: Bertrand Duperrin
reviews.summary: Points-focused traveler booked an Urban room, used suite night awards to reach a Cuscaden Suite, and admired the minimalist white-and-wood design, gym, pool, spa and bar, calling it a high-quality property worth recommending.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: The Singapore Edition At Cuscaden Road
reviews.author: The Ranting Panda
reviews.summary: Reviewer highlights the elegant lobby with its centerpiece spiral staircase, garden-themed interiors, minimalist wood rooms, FYSH dining and rooftop pool, with the only gripe being a limited a la carte breakfast spread.

reviews.title: [Hotel Review] The Singapore EDITION
reviews.author: Satu Kosong
reviews.summary: A Bonvoy member redeemed a free-night award, got a three-tier upgrade to a Garden Premier King, and praised the minimalist design and standout breakfast service, but flagged a closed pool, weak shower pressure and checkout confusion.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: The Singapore EDITION (Garden King)
reviews.author: Shawn Loh
reviews.summary: Reviewer redeemed 40,000 Bonvoy points for a Garden King, admiring the bronze-and-glass facade, FYSH breakfast, Punch Room and Lobby Bar cocktails, a 43m rooftop pool and heartfelt service at this exclusive social destination.
